initialization_coupling.dimension_character: The codebase makes frequent use of init() functions and global singletons for state that remains static during a process lifetime. While mostly safe, some initializations perform non-trivial work (WASM decompression) or depend on environment inspection (testing mode flag) at import time.
initialization_coupling.score_rationale: Score is slightly docked for the heavy work in internal/build/build.go's init() which could be lazy-loaded, and the reliance on os.Args inspection in builder/run/builder.go which can be fragile across different test runners.
